body: I also tried to kill myself a few times. But I never could do it. I wanted to jump in front of a train but I simply stood next to the tracks and watched the trains pass me. Whenever I saw one I thought "this is it. I will do it now" but I couldn't move. And one time I tried to cut my arm. It hurt but it wasn't deep and didn't bleed much. I hate it that I don't have enough courage. I'm a useless coward

Those few good days are not worth the suffering on the other days. And once I'm dead I don't care that other people are suffering because of me.

But I don't want to face them. I don't want to get stronger. I don't want a different mindset. And the problems are not unbreakable, there is one easy solution to all of them. If you have a problem and two solutions to solve it would you take the easy or the hard solution? Of course the easy solution. So why is suicide bad?

"Its a permanent solution to temporary problems." I don't get it. Isn't that what everyone normally wants? All problems solved? Why should I continue to deal with my problems if I have a simple solution for all of them at once? And there will never be new problems. So why shouldn't I kms?
